@PaulyG103 Much love to you, Jacob, and your family at this time, and to the whole Black community of southeast Wisconsin, that now lives in more acute fear. We must defeat this scourge of racism. We WILL defeat it.
#BlackLivesMatter
#KenoshaShooting
#JusticeForJacobBlake

Fuck. The #KenoshaShooting is far from the first police shooting of a Black person in my area, but watching the video, then live feeds of ppl expressing legitimate fury in places I know well, & seeing national voices RT & comment... #ThisIsAmerica.
#BlackLivesMatter
#JacobBlake
